ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity black pixels across approximately 95% of the surface area, with high-intensity white clusters localized at the distal tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Solid black pigmentation field covering central, proximal, and mid-lobe regions; high-contrast white contiguous geometric clusters at the extreme left and right distal tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped median notch with an acute internal angle and high vertical bounding-box depth relative to the lobe chord.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Low-amplitude, high-frequency serrations along the primary trailing edge; high-amplitude, irregular peaks and valleys concentrated at the distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Linear to slightly concave trailing edge profile sweeping outward from the median notch toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-contrast white pixel clusters localized at the distal tips of both lobes; sparse, individual white circular spots distributed across the black field.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: One prominent, curved, horizontal high-contrast linear mark on the mid-section of the right lobe; several faint, short vertical linear disruptions on both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Notable curvilinear white scar on the right lobe mid-field; extensive high-contrast scarring or colonization at both lobe tips.
other_distinctive_markers: Fine stochastic white speckling pattern across the entire black pigmentation of both the left and right lobes.
